description: This file defines the configuration class for the OpenID Authentication Plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the plugin configuration interface, initializes the plugin by registering a social media authentication service into the dependency injection container.

classes.name: OpenidAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the OpenID Authentication plugin, responsible for initializing and registering the social media authentication service.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the SocialMediaAuthenticationService into the service container.
